title: East of Eden
author: John Steinbeck
current_text: East of Eden was removed from school libraries in Anniston, Alabama, in 1982 after being called “ungodly and obscene,” then reinstated on a restricted basis. East of Eden was challenged in the Greenville, South Carolina, schools in 1991.

sources.quote: Oprah's Book Club's recent selection, John Steinbeck's East of Eden, was called "ungodly and obscene" in Anniston, Alabama, where it was removed, then reinstated on a restricted basis in the town's school libraries in 1982.
